messages:
incbot: ALERT: paging-multiplexer (mx-01) failing to fanout pages for ~5m, route_id=mx-01, queued=120, failures=23 :warning:
Asha: saw this — our customer-facing alerts for notify-prod are showing delayed pages, oncall didn't get anything
ben: reported customer call just now — they didn’t get an SMS page. can someone confirm if mobile relay is affected or mux is the root cause?
carla: oncall (pager 2) says no incoming pages. checked pager logs -> no webhook attempts from our side in the window
dmitri: looking at mux logs now, seeing repeated backpressure errors and `fanout_loop` stuck on mutex acquire. snippet:
```
ERROR mux/fanout.go:412: enqueue failed: channel blocked for 120s
stack: runtime.selectgo+0x...
```
Asha: can we manual-page oncall while we triage? ops-runbook, please run manual ringdown + confirm customer impact
ops-runbook: doing manual page to oncall now (phone + sms). also opening a PagerDuty manual incident to make sure escalation happens.
oncall-sre: acked via phone — I'm on it. can someone find which deploy/commit touched mux config?
dmitri: no recent deploys to mux cluster in last 6h. suspect backlog + flow-control regression from yesterday's runtime bump
ben: I can confirm one customer (ACME Corp) reported missed SMS at 13:07 UTC. potential S2 for missed oncall + customer impact. tagging support to reach out
carla: quick mitigation plan: 1) temporarily re-route paging traffic to mx-02 via feature flag 2) restart mx-01 to clear backlog 3) monitor fanout success rate
sre-lead: +1 to that. do the re-route first to avoid losing more pages during restart
dmitri: re-route command applied: `curl -XPOST https://infra-api/reconfig -d '{"route":"mx-02"}'` — confirmed responses 200
ops-runbook: issuing restart: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/mux-01`
incbot: SYSTEM: deployment/mux-01 restart started at 6881012362 (pods terminating)
Asha: post-restart logs show mux-01 recovered and drain processed ~110 backlog items, fanout success rate back to normal :thumbsup:
ben: monitoring shows pages delivered to SMS gateway again, PD triggers firing as expected for new alerts
carla: ops-runbook, please keep the manual PD incident open until we have 30m of stable fanout metrics
ops-runbook: keeping it open. creating follow-up ticket for postmortem and to add a circuit-breaker metric alert for mux backpressure
sre-lead: assign to dmitri + carla for follow-up. possible root cause: flow-control tighten after runtime change, missing fallback to direct queue. we should add a canary test to emulate high fanout
Asha: customer impact summary for postmortem: ~23 attempted pages failed during 13:02-13:09 UTC, 1 confirmed customer-visible missed SMS (ACME), manual paging succeeded for others. S2-ish.
dmitri: will collect logs, stack traces and create a postmortem draft. plan to revert aggressive flow-control patch and release a soft-limit fix
incbot: NOTE: incidentbot fanout healthcheck alert suppressed while ops triage in progress
carla: thanks team — will update #status and send a short customer note via support once postmortem draft is ready
Asha: closing manual paging runbook and handing back to normal automation. great response, landing follow-ups in JIRA: INFRA-4523
ops-runbook: closing PD manual incident at 6881012410 after stable metrics recorded
incbot: RESOLVED: mux-01 recovered and routing fallback applied. Postmortem to be filed under INFRA-4523. :white_check_mark:
